_why: The Buddy Floater's own floating window (BuddyWelcome/BuddyNewSessionForm/BuddyResumeList) had ZERO screenshots anywhere — flagged as one of only two surfaces EXCLUDED BY DESIGN from the capture tool (completeness-screens.md, 2026-09-23 audit): shot.mjs's target picker skips any real Electron window whose URL matches 'buddy' when attaching to the live app over CDP (ATTACH_PORT mode only). That exclusion never applies here: `?mode=workbench&child=1&view=buddy-session` (index.tsx, existing route, not new) renders the SHIPPING <BuddyWelcome/> as its own standalone page in the headless workbench, which always creates a fresh CDP target and never goes through the ATTACH target-picker at all. No shot.mjs change needed or made. `?bare=1` (BuddySessionScreens.tsx) drops the explainer text and lets the panel fill the whole viewport at the floater's REAL 320×480 size (CHAT_SIZE, shared/buddy-geometry.ts) — set as this plan's width/height so the model picker and other viewport-clamped popovers clip exactly as they do in the real floater.
